runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: Diversified public-index sweep covered Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Sluzby zamestnanosti, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new promotion-grade candidate surfaced in this run. Search indexing was sparse, so sources without concrete current detail evidence are recorded as checked/limited rather than credited with hits. Facebook has 0 verified hits. Existing LIVE jobs remain fail-closed because the GitHub connector truncates jobs-data.json and safe complete round-trip replacement is unavailable.

developmentChanges.title: Search-result evidence floor
developmentChanges.reason: Require a concrete current job-detail result before a source receives a hit; generic articles, category pages and stale snippets must not inflate coverage or source-success analytics.

developmentChanges.title: Connector round-trip health check
developmentChanges.reason: Before mutating large feed files, verify that the repository connector can return the complete current blob. If it truncates content, automatically fail closed and record the write blocker instead of risking destructive replacement.
